# MWI Malawi — notes

Found: Malawi Police Service Annual Report 2023 (https://www.police.gov.mw/sites/default/files/2024-03/Malawi%20Police%20Service%20Annual%20Report%202023.pdf, direct download + pdftotext). Table 4 "Number of Criminal Cases Recorded by Stations in 2023" has a Murder column for 47 police stations; they add up to 914, the same as the national figure. Only 2023 is broken down by station. National murder totals for 2021–2023 (758, 794, 914) come from Table 3.

Limits:
- Table 4 lists stations without region headings, so `parent` is blank. Table 2 (all-offence crime by district within regions CWR/CER/SWR/SER/NR/ER) shows the region structure but has no murder column. It was not extracted because it counts all offences, not homicide.
- Station names are kept as printed, including "Monk eBay" (Monkey Bay) and "Nkhatabay".
- The measure is "Murder" as recorded by police. There is no manslaughter or infanticide column.
- The PDF has no licence or copyright statement.
- Only the 2023 report is on police.gov.mw. The "Publications and Reports" page (https://www.police.gov.mw/resources/publications-and-reports) lists only policies, and the 2023 report URL came from a search. Earlier reports were not found online.
- NSO Statistical Yearbooks 2018, 2022 and 2023 (cms.nsomalawi.mw; istmat.org mirror) were downloaded and searched. None has a murder, homicide or crime table.
- Press reports (mwnation.com, mbc.mw) cite regional homicide figures for 2024/2025. They are not official tables and were not opened.
